title: Siman 312
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: כְּשֶׁנָּסַעלְנָאוְורִיטְשׁ בִּהְיוֹתוֹ יוֹשֵׁב עַל הָעֲגָלָה אָמַר יֵשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי לְהַחֲזִיר כָּל
segments.en: (22.) "With the smallest of our people — something will be done with him in the world that has not been done with [anyone] of today's..."
